chapter: Faith, Paris life and later years
title: His own school and the dishonest partner
summary: His own school and the Clarke-Bohlen Big Band ended after a partner cheated him during his absences.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: So, but -- so did you -- so do you -- you say like your own school. Do you operate that from home?
No, I stopped -- I gave that up too.
Yeah. I had some mishaps with that, you know. I had a partner who wasn't very honest.
You know, when I would go -- because I was absent quite a bit.
We formed the Clarke-Bohlen Big Band, you know.
Yeah, and we would be absent quite a bit. So the girl -- the secretary would tell me, she says, "During your absence this man is stealing you blind, Kenny," and things like that.
So I had to give that up too.
